method: Independent evaluation from plan.json, cards.json and results/*.json only (no model source, no simulator runs). For every expectation the quantity was recomputed from the 20 Hz series with small Python scripts in /tmp/ft-eval21/scripts (values at given times, extrema, first-order fits of delay/time constant, unwrapped heading, period and time-to-double from extrema, log-decrement damping, linear superposition of F2 to separate pitch-coupled roll in F8), rather than relying on metrics whose definitions differ (e.g. H6 time-to-double). Verdicts follow the given PASS/NEAR/FAIL/N/A rules, weighted by the author's confidence; every red flag was checked against the series. Flown deviations (H8a/H8b entry at 1,534 fpm, H8b pitch to -10 deg absolute, F6 flown at 4,000 ft with the collective slightly off the stop in steady autorotation) are noted where they matter.
summary: Overall the model behaves like a counter-clockwise-rotor EC135. Every rotation-direction [ROT] sign comes out as for the real aircraft: left skid low with left pedal in the hover, nose right with collective, nose left at power loss, right pedal with speed and in autorotation, and left roll in retreating-blade stall. So the rotor-direction correction in the plan is in effect. All high-confidence expectations pass. The most convincing parts are the trims, the vortex-ring and autorotation behaviour, and the stability modes. Trims: hover phi -3.4 deg, 442 kW; power bucket with its minimum near 62 kt; monotonic nose-down attitude with speed. Vortex ring: collective alone loses 873 ft with 29 % thrust surges, while the classical recovery loses 99 ft. Autorotation: 1,980 fpm at 65 kt, NR 99.8 %. Stability modes: hover phugoid period 13 s with time to double 4.8 s; Dutch roll period 2.55 s with damping ratio 0.32; positive speed stability; stall-limited 2 g pull-up; full roll control at low g; kinematically exact 30 deg turn. The weak points are in rotor-speed recovery and yaw. In the hover power loss, NR keeps falling after the lever is down and is only 75.8 % at 5 s (expected 85-105 %): red flag and card FAIL. After a hover pedal step, the yaw rate stalls near 25 deg/s instead of decaying. In the hover, the aircraft yaws by itself with lateral or longitudinal drift (8.8 deg/s in H2, 7.4 deg/s in H3). At 100 kt the yaw due to lateral cyclic is proverse. At 135 kt power and collective are higher than predicted (1.32x hover power; collective +4.0 deg). The stall roll-off at 140 kt is about 1.7x the estimated bank change. Some large coupled responses are not covered by any card: a 20 deg left roll after the F5 speed step, and a 35 deg bank with -0.23 g at the fixed-control entry to the F6 autorotation. They are plausible in sign but worth a closer look.
top_findings: H7 (hover power loss, medium confidence, red flag): with the lever fully down from 2.0 s, NR keeps falling from 76.5 % (2.8 s, descent 2,080 fpm) to a minimum of 74.4 % at 4.0 s (3,330 fpm) and is only 75.8 % at 5 s, against a minimum at 1.3-2.5 s and NR(5 s) = 85-105 %. A gauge-relative NR would read ~6 points low during the 150 deg/s co-rotating spin, which does not close the gap.

H4 (hover pedal step): after the pedal returns to trim at 4 s, r decays only from 37.9 to 25.1 deg/s by 6 s and levels off near 25 deg/s. The equivalent time constant is ~4.9 s against 1.4-3 s, and against the 2.0 s the same model shows during the build-up, which points to a residual nose-right yaw moment.

F1 (power curve): at 135 kt the collective is +4.0 deg above hover (expected -1.5..+2.5 deg, FAIL) and power is 584 kW = 1.32x hover power (expected 0.8-1.2, NEAR). The high-speed power and collective rise is steeper than predicted, while the hover power (442 kW) sits at the floor of its 440-570 kW band.

H2 (hover lateral pulse): with the pedals fixed the aircraft yaws right by itself up to 8.85 deg/s (heading +28 deg in 6 s) against |r| < 5 deg/s. The roll rate peaks early (8.3 deg/s at 0.45 s) and sags 21 % while the stick is held, and the bank starts decaying immediately after release (p about -2.5 deg/s by 1.5 s) rather than being held. H3 shows the same yaw coupling (7.4 deg/s by 6 s).

F3 (lateral pulse at 100 kt): the initial yaw is proverse (+1.2 deg/s nose right during the roll-in) instead of the small adverse yaw implied by the identified Np = -0.2..-0.35 1/s. Low confidence and small in size, but the sign is wrong.

F7 (retreating-blade stall at 140 kt): direction correct (pitch-up, left roll, stall at 309 deg azimuth on the retreating side), but the roll-off reaches p = -57.5 deg/s and a bank change of -59.5 deg at 2.75 s, about 1.7x the -35 deg upper estimate. About 41-46 % of the disc stays stalled until 4.5 s, even after the load factor falls back to 1.4-1.5 g.
F9/F2 (100 kt): with the ball centred the model trims with beta = +3.4 deg in level flight and +3.55 deg in the 30 deg turn, slightly over the |beta| <= 3 deg expectation.

Not covered by any expectation: the F5 +5 m/s speed step at 80 kt with fixed controls also gives a 20 deg left bank and a -34 deg heading change in 10 s (r about -4 deg/s). The F6 fixed-control failure entry at 100 kt reaches -35 deg bank, -20 deg pitch and -0.23 g (slightly negative rotor thrust), and needs full cyclic to recover. Both are plausible in sign, but they are large and should be reviewed.

cards.headline: The hover trim looks like a real counter-clockwise-rotor EC135: hangs left skid low, left pedal, nose slightly up, power at the low end of the expected band.

expectations.observed: phi = -3.44 deg (left skid low), steady over 5 s.
expectations.comment: Inside -4.5..-1.0; [ROT] sign matches the CCW rotor (high-confidence sign).

expectations.observed: theta = +3.12 deg.
expectations.comment: Inside +1..+6.

expectations.observed: Total 442.2 kW; main rotor 385.0 kW; Fenestron 37.2 kW; T = 25.1 kN (T/W 1.024).
expectations.comment: Total sits 2 kW above the 440 kW floor of the band. Main rotor inside 380-470; Fenestron slightly below the 40-70 kW sub-estimate.

expectations.observed: ped = -0.384 (left of centre); every forward-flight pedal is to the right (F1: -0.211 at 40 kt, +0.21..+0.45 at 60-135 kt; T1 40 kt: -0.26).
expectations.comment: Inside -0.7..+0.05 and clearly left of all cruise positions.

expectations.observed: col = 0.552 of range.
expectations.comment: Inside 0.5-0.8.

cards.headline: Right stick rolls the hovering aircraft right at the expected rate, but the bank does not hold after release and the aircraft yaws right by itself (up to 8.8 deg/s) with the pedals fixed.

expectations.observed: p rises with ~0.06 s delay and ~0.20 s time constant, peaks at +8.32 deg/s at 0.45 s, then sags to +6.58 deg/s at 1.0 s while the stick is still held.
expectations.comment: Peak magnitude inside +7..+12 and the rise matches; the peak comes at 0.45 s instead of 0.7-1.15 s because p falls ~21 % during the held input (lateral speed already builds a left-roll moment).

expectations.observed: phi peaks at +7.2 deg (relative to trim) at 1.25-1.3 s. After release p crosses zero within 0.3 s but continues to -2.5 deg/s by 1.5 s and stays at -2..-4.5 deg/s; the bank falls to +5.7 deg at 2.0 s and +2.65 deg at 3.0 s.
expectations.comment: Peak size and timing inside 6-12 deg at 1.2-2 s. The 'bank is held' part is not met: p does not settle near zero, it reverses. The decay matches lateral-speed dihedral (v ~1-2 m/s, effective Lv ~ -0.13 1/(m s)), not an attitude spring, and starts ~1 s earlier than the card assumed.

expectations.observed: Lateral ground speed peaks at 2.25 m/s (body v 2.37 m/s) at 3.45-3.65 s. phi passes back through trim at ~3.4 s and is -7.1 deg relative to trim at 6 s (14.3 deg below its peak).
expectations.comment: Inside 1.5-4 m/s at 2-4 s; the hover lateral oscillation has started as predicted.

expectations.observed: |q| peak 1.55 deg/s (0.75 s) in the first 3 s; theta +2.3 deg at 3 s (+6.0 deg by 6 s).
expectations.comment: Well under 5 deg/s and 5 deg in the first 3 s.

expectations.observed: r grows steadily with no pedal input: 1.1 deg/s during the pulse, 4.8 deg/s at 3 s, maximum +8.85 deg/s at 5.5 s; heading +28 deg after 6 s.
expectations.comment: Outside |r| < 5 by 77 % (beyond the NEAR margin). Low-confidence expectation, so weight is limited. The yaw tracks the rightward drift (consistent with a fin/Fenestron Nv of ~0.02 rad/s^2 per m/s with Nr ~ -0.5), which is physical in sign but larger than the author allowed.

cards.headline: Forward stick in the hover pitches the nose down at the expected rate, the aircraft accelerates forward and the nose comes back up as a growing pitch oscillation, as a hingeless-rotor helicopter should.

expectations.observed: q peak -9.94 deg/s at 1.0 s (end of the pulse), still building (86 % of a fitted -11.5 deg/s steady value). First-order fit: 0.08 s delay, time constant 0.415 s. After release q decays with a time constant of ~0.3-0.4 s.
expectations.comment: Peak and timing inside -13..-5 at 0.9-1.2 s. The pitch time constant (0.415 s) is just under the 0.45-0.85 s band; still ~2x slower than roll (0.20 s), so the qualitative point holds.

expectations.observed: theta minimum -9.62 deg (relative to trim) at 1.7 s; pitch keeps moving for 0.7 s after release.
Forward speed peaks at 3.66 m/s (u 3.75 m/s) at 3.9 s. theta returns through trim at ~4.0 s and is +11.7 deg nose-up relative to trim at 6 s (still rising at 5 deg/s).
expectations.comment: Inside 2-7 m/s at 3-5.5 s; nose return between 2.5 and 6 s and nose-up at 6 s, as predicted. The overshoot (+11.7 deg) is larger than the initial excursion: the hover phugoid is strongly excited.

expectations.observed: |p| peak 2.85 deg/s at 0.6 s (right roll); phi +2.68 deg at 3 s.
expectations.comment: Under 6 deg/s and 6 deg. (Unscored: r reaches 7.4 deg/s and heading +16.5 deg by 6 s with fixed pedals.)

cards.headline: Right pedal turns the nose right with a realistic build-up and unloads the Fenestron, but after the pedal returns to trim the yaw rate levels off near 25 deg/s instead of dying away.

expectations.observed: r(1 s) = +17.1, r(2 s) = +24.4, r(4 s) = +37.9 deg/s, still rising at 4 s; first-order fit time constant 2.0 s (steady ~41 deg/s).
expectations.comment: All three inside their bands; nose right (high-confidence sign).

expectations.observed: Heading change at 6 s = +151 deg. After release r goes 37.9 (4.0 s), 31.6 (4.4 s), 29.4 (4.6 s), 27.0 (5.0 s), 25.8 (5.5 s), 25.1 (6.0 s) deg/s: fast initial drop, then a plateau near 25 deg/s. No oscillation.
expectations.comment: Heading inside 40-250 deg and no oscillation, but the decay shape is wrong: after 2 s r is still 66 % of its release value (equivalent time constant ~4.9 s vs 1.4-3 s, and vs the 2.0 s seen during build-up), and it is levelling off at a non-zero rate with the pedal back at trim. Low-confidence expectation.
[ROT] sign right (high confidence) and inside -15..-45 %; total-power drop in or just past the 2-5 % estimate.

expectations.observed: Euler phi change max +1.85 deg, but body roll rate p is negative throughout (-0.5..-5.4 deg/s); the positive phi comes from the r*tan(theta) term at 38 deg/s yaw rate. Ground drift is to the left of the initial heading (vE -2.3 m/s). |Vz| max 164 fpm (descent). NR 99.4-100.6 %.
expectations.comment: All inside the bounds; body-axis roll and drift are leftward as the [ROT] note predicted.

cards.headline: Raising the collective in the hover gives a realistic climb with a lagged build-up, a nose-right yaw from the extra torque, and a small, quickly recovered rotor-speed droop.

expectations.observed: Peak vertical acceleration +0.118 g = 1.16 m/s^2 at 0.1 s, falling to 0.07 g by 0.4 s and 0.01 g by 6 s. Fitted heave time constant 2.45-2.6 s (steady ~485 fpm). Vz(2 s) = +258 fpm, Vz(6 s) = +434 fpm.
expectations.comment: Acceleration, timing, time constant and Vz(6 s) inside their bands (time constant at the low edge).

expectations.observed: r rises steadily nose right: +7.7 (1 s), +15.7 (2 s), +25.6 deg/s (6 s); heading +98 deg at 6 s.
expectations.comment: [ROT] sign right (high confidence); r(6 s) inside +8..+50.
Inside +8..+22 % and roughly constant.

expectations.observed: NR minimum 99.65 % (0.35 % droop) at 0.4-0.6 s, back to 100 % by ~1.2 s, small overshoot to 100.25 %.
expectations.comment: Droop inside 0.3-3 %; recovery is faster than the 2-5 s estimate, read here as an upper bound. NR never below 97 %.

cards.headline: Left alone in the hover, the aircraft drifts into a growing pitch-and-roll oscillation with a period of about 13 s that doubles in about 5 s, which is the expected hingeless-rotor hover instability.

expectations.observed: theta extrema (relative to trim): +0.79 (1.0 s), -1.42 (7.55 s), +3.57 (14.2 s), -9.37 (20.55 s), +14.3 deg and rising at 25 s.
expectations.comment: Oscillatory and divergent (high confidence).

expectations.observed: Period from zero crossings 12.75-13.25 s (half-periods 6.35-6.65 s).
expectations.comment: Inside 7-16 s and inside the central 9-13 s estimate.

expectations.observed: Amplitude ratio per half-cycle 2.52 and 2.63; log-fit time to double 4.8 s (4.6-5.0 s per half-cycle). The metric's 14.2 s uses a different definition.
expectations.comment: Inside 3-30 s and the central 5-12 s estimate (at its lower edge).

expectations.observed: theta peaks +0.785 deg at 1.0 s as q decays; u goes negative (-0.09 m/s at 1 s, -0.31 m/s at 3.5 s); nose passes down through trim at 3.8 s; later swings exceed the first.
expectations.comment: Sequence exactly as predicted; the first peak is 0.015 deg under the 0.8 deg floor and the nose-down crossing is at 3.8 s against '~4-8 s'. Marginal.

expectations.observed: |phi| exceeds 1 deg at 9 s and reaches 10.8 deg at 23 s; v reaches 4.5 m/s; r up to 10.8 deg/s and heading swings of +/-12 deg.
expectations.comment: Coupled lateral motion grows as expected.

cards.headline: A double engine failure in the hover yaws the nose left as on the real aircraft, but with the lever fully down the rotor speed keeps falling into the descent and is still only 76 % after 5 s.

expectations.observed: Nose left: r = -85.5 deg/s at 1.0 s, -123.5 at 2 s, -154 at 5 s; initial yaw acceleration ~-117 deg/s^2; heading change -592 deg by 5 s.
expectations.comment: [ROT] sign right (high confidence); r(1 s) inside -100..-40 and still growing; heading change well over 180 deg.

expectations.observed: Initial NR decay 16.7 %/s (first 0.1 s), 16.0 %/s average over 0.5 s; NR(1.0 s) = 85.4 %.
expectations.comment: Inside 10-22 %/s and 78-90 %.

expectations.observed: Decay rate falls as the lever goes down (12 %/s at 1.0 s, 5.8 %/s at 1.6 s, 2.4 %/s at 2.5-3 s) but does not reverse: NR 78.5 % (2.0 s), 76.5 % (2.8 s), 76.0 % (3.0 s), minimum 74.4 % at 4.0 s, 75.8 % at 5 s (rising ~1.8 %/s).
expectations.comment: Minimum value is inside 72-90 %, but it comes at 4.0 s instead of 1.3-2.5 s, and NR(5 s) = 75.8 % is far below 85-105 % (more than 9 points under, beyond the NEAR margin). Medium confidence. Caveat: the fuselage spins at ~150 deg/s in the rotor's own direction; if NR is measured relative to the fuselage, the rotor's speed relative to the air is ~6 points higher (~82 % at 5 s), still short of the band.

expectations.observed: Downward acceleration 0.194 g at 1.0 s; peak 0.63 g at 1.65 s, ~0.6 g until 3.0 s, then 0.41 g at 4 s and 0.19 g at 5 s. Descent 3,876 fpm at 5 s.
expectations.comment: All inside the stated ranges.

red_flags_seen: NR still falling after the lever is fully down (2.0 s) and the descent has passed 2,000 fpm: 76.5 % at 2.8 s (2,080 fpm) down to 74.4 % at 4.0 s (3,330 fpm). Marginal in size (about 2 points), but it matches the flag's wording.

cards.headline: In a vortex ring, raising the collective alone does not stop the sink, which gets worse (to about 3,200 fpm) with large irregular thrust surges, as flight tests on real helicopters show.

expectations.observed: Flown entry: -1,534 fpm (not 1,800) with ring depth 0.93 and still accelerating downward (nz 0.87). After +0.15 collective: Vz -2,421 fpm at 5 s, -3,010 at 10 s, worst -3,175 at 9 s, -2,757 at 20 s. Never above -500 fpm.
expectations.comment: Sink not arrested; 5 s value well above 1,000 fpm; stays in 1,200-4,000 fpm. The shallower entry (0.68 vh instead of 0.80 vh) is still inside the VRS band.

expectations.observed: Height lost 873 ft in 20 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 300-1,500 ft.

expectations.observed: Rotor thrust 20.5-27.4 kN, 29 % peak-to-peak of the mean (nz 0.84-1.13 g), with irregular swings at ~3-6 s spacing. Attitudes held tightly by the pilot loop (theta range 0.5 deg, phi 2.5 deg), r -2.5..+6.4 deg/s.
expectations.comment: Magnitude and periods inside the expected 10-40 % and 1-6 s. Uncommanded attitude wandering is small, but the pilot loop is holding attitude.

expectations.observed: Power 340 kW at entry -> 529 kW by 3 s, max 542 kW (1.23x the 442 kW hover power). NR transient minimum 97.5 % at 0.5 s, then 99.9-100.8 %.
expectations.comment: Power above hover power; no engine saturation, so no sustained droop.

cards.headline: The classical vortex-ring escape (nose down for speed plus collective) works quickly: climbing within 6 s, about 100 ft lost against about 870 ft with collective alone.

expectations.observed: Same entry as H8a. The attitude pilot pitched to about -10 deg absolute (about 13 deg below the +3 deg entry attitude). Horizontal airspeed 15 kt at 3.4 s, 20.6 kt at 4.5 s, 22.9 kt at 5.0 s; ring depth 0 from 4.5 s.
expectations.comment: 15-22 kt reached inside 3-6 s.

expectations.observed: Vz above -500 fpm at 4.35 s; climb (Vz > 0) from 6.0 s; peak climb +490 fpm at ~11 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 4-10 s; climb well before 12 s.

expectations.observed: Height lost 99 ft (minimum altitude at 6.0 s).
expectations.comment: Inside 80-400 ft.

expectations.observed: Height lost 99 ft vs 873 ft in H8a (factor 8.8); time to climb 6.0 s vs never in H8a.
expectations.comment: High-confidence ordering confirmed.

cards.headline: Accelerating from the hover to 40 kt shows translational lift, growing forward stick, a left-cyclic transverse-flow excursion and right pedal, all in the right direction and size.

expectations.observed: Power 442 kW (0-5 kt), 432 (10 kt), 394 (20 kt), 353 (30 kt), 326 kW (40 kt): ratio 0.741. Steepest fall 10-30 kt (~4 kW/kt), slower above 30 kt.
expectations.comment: Ratio inside 0.55-0.80; shape as predicted.

expectations.observed: lon -0.370 (hover) -> -0.139 at 40 kt (+0.231 forward), monotonic.
theta drops from +3.12 to about -0.1..-0.55 deg during the acceleration (-3.2 to -3.7 deg); returns to +2.7..+3.0 deg once the acceleration stops at 40 kt.
expectations.comment: Inside -2..-6 deg.

expectations.observed: lat moves left: -0.03 (5 kt), -0.06 (10 kt), -0.10 (20 kt), minimum -0.139 relative to hover at 25 kt, then -0.11..-0.12 to 40 kt.
expectations.comment: [ROT] direction right; size inside -0.25..-0.02 with the maximum at 25 kt. The excursion only partly washes out above 25 kt (still ~80 % at 40 kt), so it is a ramp-and-plateau rather than a 10-25 kt hump.

expectations.observed: ped -0.384 -> -0.259 at 40 kt (+0.125 right), mostly between 10 and 40 kt.
expectations.comment: [ROT] direction right (high confidence); inside +0.05..+0.5.

expectations.observed: col 0.552 -> 0.441 at 40 kt (-0.111 = -1.6 deg), tracking power.
expectations.comment: Inside -0.28..-0.10 (near the small-change edge).

cards.headline: The power curve has the right bucket shape and the minimum near 62 kt, but at high speed power and collective climb more steeply than predicted (135 kt needs 1.32 times hover power and the collective sits 4 deg above hover).

expectations.comment: Bucket with Vmp inside 55-85 kt and ratio inside 0.45-0.65; steep rise above 100 kt.
All seven inside their bands, though hover is at the bottom edge and 120/135 kt are near the top.
0.12 above the 0.8-1.2 band (10 %). Comes from a low hover power combined with a high 135 kt power; each is inside its own band.

expectations.observed: theta relative to hover: -0.78 (40 kt), -2.40 (60 kt), -3.85 (80 kt), -5.45 (100 kt), -7.0 (120 kt), -8.05 deg (135 kt); monotonic.
Collective relative to hover (14.5 deg range): -2.0 (40 kt), -2.3 (60 kt), -1.7 (80 kt), -0.3 (100 kt), +1.9 (120 kt), +4.0 deg (135 kt). Fitted minimum ~56-60 kt.
expectations.comment: Bucket, minimum speed and depth (0.158 of range) are right. At 135 kt the collective is +4.0 deg against a -1.5..+2.5 deg band: 1.5 deg over, more than a quarter of the 4-deg band. Medium confidence. The author's own BO-105 data (+4.8 deg at 145 kt) suggests the band was tight.

expectations.observed: ped relative to hover: +0.17 (40 kt), +0.59 (60 kt), +0.70 (80 kt), +0.81 (100 kt), +0.84 (120 kt), +0.81 (135 kt). Absolute 0.21-0.45 right of centre from 60 kt.
expectations.comment: Well right of hover at all speeds; most right at 120 kt; variation over 60-135 kt (0.24) smaller than over 0-60 kt (0.59). (Pedal rule: nose on track at 40 kt, ball centred from 80 kt, blended at 60 kt.)

cards.headline: A small fore-aft stick doublet at 100 kt gives a crisp, well-damped pitch response with the right load-factor changes and no lasting drift.

expectations.observed: q -3.19 deg/s at 0.6 s, then +4.70 deg/s at 1.6 s.
expectations.comment: Inside -2..-6 and +2..+5.

expectations.observed: theta min -2.56 deg at 1.2 s; +1.1 deg overshoot at 2.3 s, +0.49 deg at 3 s, +0.18 deg at 8 s.
expectations.comment: Minimum and timing inside range; back near trim by 2.5-3 s; no divergence.

expectations.observed: Airspeed change max 0.64 kt; |p| peak 2.18 deg/s vs |q| peak 4.70 deg/s.

cards.headline: A right stick pulse at 100 kt rolls the aircraft right by the expected amount and the bank persists, but the first yaw is slightly nose right instead of the expected small nose-left adverse yaw.

expectations.observed: p peak +10.7 deg/s at 0.65 s (flat at 10.5-10.7 from 0.5 to 1.0 s).
expectations.comment: Inside +6..+13 at 0.7-1.1 s (peak plateau spans the window).

expectations.observed: phi change +10.35 deg at 1.4 s, +7.5 deg at 4 s, +5.5 deg at 8 s; r ~1.0-1.4 deg/s (a coordinated gentle turn).
expectations.comment: Inside +5..+13 and no rapid return. The bank decays with a ~13 s time constant (mildly stable spiral) where the identified 60 kt spiral is mildly unstable; still 'near neutral'.

expectations.observed: During the roll-in r goes nose RIGHT (+1.23 deg/s at 0.35-0.4 s). A nose-left swing (-1.2 deg/s at 1.35 s) appears only when the stick returns. Then Dutch-roll overshoot to +3.4 deg/s at 2.5 s and r = 0.89 (4 s), 1.36 (5 s), 1.19 (6 s), 0.99 deg/s (8 s).
expectations.comment: The initial yaw has the wrong sign (proverse instead of adverse, i.e. the model's yaw due to roll rate or lateral stick is positive, unlike the identified Np = -0.2..-0.35). The later r is at/just below the 1-5 deg/s floor, consistent with the ~7 deg bank. Low-confidence expectation; magnitudes are small.

expectations.observed: beta change peaks +1.57 deg at 1.9 s (wind from the right, toward the low wing); Dutch-roll ripple with period ~2.6-2.75 s.
expectations.comment: Inside +1..+7 deg; period inside 2.5-4.5 s.

expectations.observed: |q| peak 1.64 deg/s at 0.65 s (15 % of p peak).

cards.headline: A pedal doublet at 100 kt excites a realistic, moderately damped Dutch roll (2.55 s period, damping ratio 0.32) with roll in the dihedral direction and almost no net heading change.

expectations.observed: r +4.32 deg/s at 0.55 s, then -9.12 deg/s at 1.55 s.
expectations.comment: Inside +4..+15 (near the floor) and -4..-18.

expectations.observed: beta change -3.13 deg at 1.05 s, then +4.1 deg at 2.1 s.
expectations.comment: Inside -1.5..-7 and reversing.

expectations.observed: r extrema after release: +6.97 (2.7 s), -2.41 (3.95 s), +0.86 (5.25 s), -0.24 (6.45 s), +0.19 (7.65 s). Period 2.5-2.55 s; damping ratio from log decrement 0.32.
expectations.comment: Period at the bottom edge of 2.5-4.5 s; damping inside 0.05-0.35; ~1.5-2 cycles visible.

expectations.observed: phi change +3.96 deg (1.8 s) / -1.48 deg (3.15 s) / +0.58 deg (4.5 s). p is nearly in phase with -beta (p +4.7 while beta -2.7; p -6.2 while beta +3.5); phi lags -beta by ~0.75-1 s because it integrates p. |p|/|r| ~0.9 in the oscillation.
expectations.comment: Dihedral sign right; amplitude inside 1-6 deg; |p|/|r| inside 0.3-2. 'phi in phase with -beta' holds for p rather than phi, as expected physically.

expectations.observed: Heading change at 12 s = +1.3 deg.

cards.headline: After a sudden speed increase at 80 kt the nose rises and the aircraft climbs and slows, showing positive speed stability. The same disturbance also rolls it 20 deg to the left, which the card did not cover.

expectations.observed: q +1.23 at 0.2 s, +2.25 deg/s peak at 0.5 s; theta +2.0 deg at 2 s.
expectations.comment: Nose up (high confidence).

expectations.observed: q peak +2.25 deg/s at 0.5 s; theta maximum +2.07 deg at 2.6 s, then falls (to -1.75 deg at 10 s) as the left bank turns the pitch rate into turning.
expectations.comment: q peak inside +0.5..+7 (0.1 s before the 0.6 s window); theta rise at the very bottom of +2..+20.

expectations.observed: Vz peak +397 fpm at 3.8-4.0 s.
IAS 89.5 kt just after the disturbance, 81.3 kt at 10 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 70-84 (not below 80 as 'most likely' suggested).

cards.notes: Not scored: with controls fixed the speed step also gives r = -2.8 deg/s at 0.2 s (~-4.2 deg/s sustained), p down to -6.4 deg/s, phi -19.9 deg at 6 s and a heading change of -34 deg in 10 s. The sign is physically plausible (the fin and less torque yaw the nose left as dynamic pressure rises, then dihedral rolls it left), but the size is notable and untested by the cards.

cards.headline: A double engine failure at 100 kt yaws the nose left; the rotor speed dips to 84 % and recovers; steady autorotation at 65 kt settles at about 1,980 fpm with right pedal, all as expected. The fixed-control entry is violent, with 35 deg of bank and slightly negative g.

expectations.observed: Flown at 4,000 ft (not 1,000 ft). r peak -27.6 deg/s at 0.55 s; sideslip +20.6 deg at ~1.2 s.
expectations.comment: [ROT] sign right (high confidence); inside -50..-10 at 0.5-1.5 s; sideslip inside +5..+25.

expectations.observed: Initial decay 11.5 %/s; NR(1.0 s) = 90.5 %; minimum 83.6 % at 2.85 s; recovers to a 106.5 % transient peak at 5.9 s during the flare; steady 99.8-99.9 % (with the collective at 0.093-0.10, raised slightly off the bottom stop by the pilot to hold NR near 100 %).
expectations.comment: Decay rate, NR(1 s) and the minimum value are inside their bands; the minimum is 0.35 s later than the 1.2-2.5 s window (the -0.23 g push at 2 s with fixed cyclic delays recovery). The steady 'collective full down' NR was not flown exactly.

expectations.observed: Steady 30-40 s: IAS 65.0 kt, Vz -1,980 fpm, nz 1.00.
expectations.comment: Inside 1,400-2,300 fpm (the steady segment was flown at ~2,900-3,200 ft ISA rather than 1,000 ft, which slightly favours a higher ROD).

expectations.observed: Autorotation pedal +0.886 vs powered 100 kt trim +0.407 (+0.48 of travel right; right of centre).
expectations.comment: [ROT] direction right.

expectations.observed: Vz within 10 % of the steady value from 15.8 s and NR within +/-1 % from 14.4 s, i.e. ~12-14 s after the lever reached the stop at 2 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 10-20 s.

cards.notes: Not scored: with cyclic fixed for 2 s and the lever dumped at 100 kt, the aircraft reaches phi -34.8 deg (2.25 s), theta -20.3 deg (2.3 s), p -30.7 deg/s, nz -0.23 g with rotor thrust slightly negative at 2.0-2.1 s; the autopilot then uses full aft and full right cyclic (lon -1.0, lat +1.0) and pulls 1.85 g. Physically plausible for this unrealistic fixed-control entry (20 deg sideslip x dihedral; negative rotor angle of attack at low collective), but severe.

cards.headline: A hard pull-up at 140 kt stalls the retreating (left) side of the disc: load factor flattens near 2 g, the nose keeps pitching up and the aircraft rolls left, as expected, though the left roll-off is much more violent than estimated.

expectations.observed: nz 1.24 (0.1 s), 1.42 at stall onset (0.5 s), 1.63-1.74 g plateau (0.6-1.2 s), peak 2.007 g at 1.9 s.
expectations.comment: Peak inside 1.6-2.4 g at 1.0-2.3 s; growth flattens once stall sets in (onset at 1.42 g, slightly below the 1.6-1.9 g estimate but inside F7.4's 1.4-1.8 g).

expectations.observed: q peak +21.7 deg/s at 1.1 s; theta +27.1 deg (relative) at 2.05 s, +25.0 deg at 2.5 s. After the stick returns (2.0-2.05 s) q stays positive until 2.25 s, then turns positive again from 2.55 to 4.15 s while ~40 % of the disc stays stalled.
expectations.comment: q peak and theta rise inside their bands; persistence ~0.2-0.25 s matches '~0.3 s' and the renewed pitch-up shows the stall nose-up tendency.

expectations.observed: p -5..-8 deg/s from the start (pitch-roll coupling), then -13.8 (1.4 s), -35.5 (1.7 s), -57.5 deg/s at 2.0 s. phi change -59.5 deg at 2.75 s, -55.6 at 3 s, -39.6 at 4 s, -20.9 at 5 s.
expectations.comment: [ROT] direction right: left roll, toward the retreating side, once stall develops (medium-confidence sign). The size is about 1.7x the -35 deg upper bound at 3 s; only by 5 s is it back inside. Accepted as NEAR only because the card says to read F7 'as directions and orders of magnitude'.

expectations.observed: Stalled fraction 0 in trim, 0.155 at 0.5 s (1.42 g), ~0.41 from 0.75 s, max 0.456 at 2.05 s; centroid azimuth 308.6 deg from the tail in the rotation direction (retreating/left side). Radial extent not recorded.
expectations.comment: Inside 200-340 deg; grows strongly above ~1.4 g. Radial extent N/A.

cards.headline: At about 0.6 g in a pushover the roll response to lateral stick is as strong as at 1 g, so this stiff rotor keeps full roll control at low g, as it should.

expectations.observed: nz min 0.562 g at 1.0 s.

p peak +16.4 deg/s at 1.55-1.6 s with nz rising from 0.56 g (input start) to 0.82 g at the peak. The forward stick alone had produced p = +6.2 deg/s by 1.0 s; a linear superposition using the F2 doublet shows that this coupling decays by 1.3 s, so the lateral-input part peaks at ~16.7 deg/s vs 16.1 deg/s for the 1 g F3 response scaled x1.5.
expectations.comment: Inside +8..+17; ratio to 1 g ~1.0 (>= 0.7).

expectations.observed: Roll follows the input sign, proportional, no reversal; uncommanded roll before the lateral input +4.9 deg (from pitch-roll coupling).
expectations.comment: High-confidence item met; pre-input roll below the 10 deg flag.

expectations.observed: q peak -9.38 deg/s at 0.6 s; theta min -7.68 deg relative to trim.
expectations.comment: Inside -6..-15 deg/s and -7..-20 deg.

cards.headline: A steady 30-degree turn at 100 kt has the correct turn rate, load factor and power increase; the ball-centred sideslip (3.5 deg) is slightly larger than expected.

expectations.observed: Turn rate 6.23 deg/s from heading and track slopes (15-45 s); bank 30.0 deg; TAS ~101.5 kt.
expectations.comment: Inside 6.1-6.5 (exactly g tan30/V).
Inside 1.14-1.17; equals 1/cos 30.
Inside +6..+18 %.

expectations.observed: ay = 0.002 m/s^2 (ball centred), beta = +3.55 deg (level 100 kt trim also has +3.41 deg).
expectations.comment: 0.55 deg outside |beta| <= 3 (within the NEAR margin). The model trims cruise with ~3.5 deg sideslip from the right when the ball is centred.
